Agent skills from Jane Street

A collection of skills for AI agents and chatbots. Each skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file with instructions for the agent.

Skills

  • socratic-tutor — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common SKILL.md format, copy the skill directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it ("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's SKILL.md into the chat (or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

skills.name: socratic-tutor
skills.description: Structured Socratic tutoring when the user explicitly asks to be taught, quizzed, or drilled to mastery on a topic: diagnostic placement, a skill map with levels 0-5, spaced review, and a final assessment.
